questions.title: Role scope and stance jobs for Spec delivery
questions.question: How do scoped roles and composable stances coordinate parallel Spec and Task delivery?
questions.answer: Role defines scope: Director covers project and integration, Dispatcher one Spec and its branch, Worker one Task. Spec Planner and Spec Manager are separate Dispatcher-usable stances with separate Specs. Planner prepares small parallel vertical slices and may use Workers to author Tasks; Manager dispatches and monitors execution. Reviewer and Auditor remain stances. Director coordinates cross-Spec work.

confirmation.basis: Owner explicitly confirmed ROLE-1 through ROLE-4 and the documentation/specification/integration endpoint on 2026-09-27.

questions.title: GitHub Issues as the required live coordination authority
questions.question: Which owner holds live assignment, the active Worker, operational holds and the next hand-back during normal delivery, and how does that authority replace pushed Task-branch claims without two claim authorities?
questions.answer: GitHub Issues is required live coordination for normal delivery, not an optional mirror. Issues own live assignment, the active Worker, operational holds and the next hand-back through bounded trusted operations; the request, Contract and assigned Spec and Task keep scope, requirements, acceptance and permission; native pull requests and exact commits express candidate and review activity through Workbench gates; repository evidence owners keep receipts, acceptance and owner approval. Directors resolve assignment races and the owner-designated coordinator Vespar breaks v4 ties. ADR-000O's pushed Task-branch remote-tip claim is superseded for v4 only at a separately reviewed cutover that leaves exactly one active claim authority. Issue prose, an assignee or status alone, labels and bot messages never enlarge authority, prove exclusivity or manufacture independent review or QA. Visible error and pending state and refusal of unverifiable unsafe assignments or writes are required; no atomic lock, custom scheduler or second queue.

confirmation.basis: Owner approved superseding ADR-000O and settled required Issue coordination, Director race resolution with the Vespar tie-break, and the ownership split; relayed as settled in the 2026-10-01 coordinating assignment. Trusted actor identities and migration mechanics are not confirmed.

expectedResult.change: Record the accepted destination, retained ADR-000O rationale, one-authority cutover conditions and current gaps in a proposed superseding ADR; later reconcile the shared controls and S-00V through their owners and plan the claim capability in a separately assigned Spec.

uncertainty: Trusted actor mechanics are open: which GitHub identities (owner account, GitHub App or per-agent accounts) perform trusted Issue operations, and how Director race outcomes and Vespar tie-breaks are attributed verifiably.

GitHub write capability is unverified: on 2026-10-01 the Claude cloud Workbench session read Issues and pull requests through the GitHub connector, the gh CLI token was invalid, and no write was probed.
Migration of in-progress pushed Task-branch claims (S-00V TK-01L runtime) into Issue assignment is unplanned.

questions.title: GitHub Issue graph and composed coordination views
questions.question: How do GitHub Issues and Projects represent Spec, Task, Landmark and DQC relationships and progress without forcing a tree, confusing concept Issue closure with assessment, or inventing completion?
questions.answer: GitHub Projects, the generated Taskboard and the generated Landmark Tracker are composed views, never authority. The Issue graph carries Spec-Task hierarchy, direct or ungrouped Tasks and overlapping Landmark and DQC membership as a graph, keeps native blocking links distinct from semantic relations and generated content distinct from human content, and never treats concept Issue closure as an assessment. Views keep exactly six implementation lanes and the eight steps Idea, Aligning, Confirmed, Mapped, Planned, Journey, Review and Verified with true fractions, denominators, provenance and explicit missing or invalid states, record their coordination snapshot, freshness and conflicts, keep Tracker and execution views separate, and invent no percentages. The six-lane board reuses S-01X.

confirmation.basis: The ownership split naming Projects, Taskboard and Tracker as composed views, and these representation requirements, are owner-accepted direction relayed as settled on 2026-10-01. Project availability and the direct-Task home are not confirmed.

expectedResult.change: Record the composed-view boundary in the proposed superseding ADR; later plan the Issue graph and view capabilities, reusing S-01X, S-001Z, S-002A and S-002B, in separately assigned Specs.

uncertainty: GitHub Projects capability is unverified: on 2026-10-01 no GitHub connector Projects route was available and the gh CLI token was invalid.
If Projects cannot be used through supported access, whether v4 may ship with the generated Taskboard and Tracker as its only composed views is an open owner decision.
The home for direct or ungrouped Tasks awaits the Director disposition recorded in the S-00O assigned capability map.

questions.title: GitHub-backed room binding and fresh-host continuation
questions.question: How does a room bind to its GitHub coordination repository and artifact identities, and how does a fresh host recover an assignment without the originating chat?
questions.answer: A room binds to its GitHub coordination repository and artifact identities (legacy Spec-qualified Tasks, aliases, immutable source) through supported access, with credentials kept untracked; managed adapter and skills are delivered by setup and upgrade and proved in a freshly installed room. A fresh host recovers packet, objective, scope, branch, exact SHA, proof, gap and next action from the Issue and repository owners alone, without the originating chat. Identity reuses S-01W.

confirmation.basis: Binding, setup and upgrade, and fresh-host continuation requirements are owner-accepted direction relayed as settled on 2026-10-01; the grouping into capabilities is provisional and the binding mechanism is not confirmed.

expectedResult.change: Record the cutover precondition for proved capability and fresh-host recovery in the proposed superseding ADR; later plan binding, setup and continuation capabilities in separately assigned Specs.

uncertainty: The supported binding and access route for rooms is unplanned; no GitHub adapter exists at 065a7ce.
Installed-room and cross-host proof (Claude cloud, Codex cloud, local) has not been run.

assessment.basis: Four named claims: C1-C3 are owner-accepted requirements and C4 open alignment, all stated in proposed ADR-000Q at 471a0f0. Fractions unchanged; evidence corrected.
